text.4:75: How should ye not fight for the cause of Allah and of the feeble among men and of the women and the children who are crying: Our Lord! Bring us forth from out this town of which the people are oppressors! Oh, give us from thy presence some protecting friend! Oh, give us from Thy presence some defender!
text.4:98: Except the feeble among men, and the women, and the children, who are unable to devise a plan and are not shown a way.
text.4:127: They consult thee concerning women. Say: Allah giveth you decree concerning them, and the Scripture which hath been recited unto you (giveth decree), concerning female orphans and those unto whom ye give not that which is ordained for them though ye desire to marry them, and (concerning) the weak among children, and that ye should deal justly with orphans. Whatever good ye do, lo! Allah is ever Aware of it.
text.26:18: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
text.56:17: There wait on them immortal youths
text.73:17: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
text.76:19: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
